title: Heat pump seasonal efficiency: what household estimates often miss
summary: New public guidance clarifies how climate, emitter temperature and building insulation change real seasonal efficiency, making headline performance figures insufficient for household decisions.

title: Insulation upgrades and moisture risk: the checks required before work begins
summary: A renovation sequence can improve thermal comfort while creating condensation risk when ventilation and wall composition are assessed separately rather than as one building system.

title: Renovation budgets need a contingency line: how to size it without guessing
summary: Cost ranges published by institutions are useful baselines, but surveys, access constraints and corrective work require an explicit contingency method before contractors are compared.
